blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Private Access > Private Applications > Defined Application Segments.
Locate the application segment you want to edit, and click the Edit icon.

If you selected the Show Recommendation Before Editing checkbox on the Defined Application Segments page, then go to the next step. If you did not select this option, go to Application and Ports Configuration.
See image.
In the Merge Recommended Application Segment with Defined Application Segment window:
AI-Powered Recommendation
On the AI-Powered Recommendation tab, select the AI-powered recommendation that you want to merge with the application segment, and click Next. To learn more, see Merging AI-Powered Recommendations.
See image.
Selected Segment
On the Selected Segment tab, select the necessary applications from the designated application group, and click Next.
See image.
Application and Ports Configuration
On the Application and Ports Configuration tab, modify fields as necessary. To learn more about each field, see Configuring Defined Application Segments.
See image.
Click Next.
General Information
On the General Information tab, modify any fields as necessary. To learn more about each field, see Configuring Application Segments.
If you select multiple server groups when editing, only one server group should be saved. Multiple server groups mapped to the same application segment can cause the console to disconnect.
If there are required fields missing, the Incomplete Configuration icon appears next to the missing item.
Click Save.
